findings.source_quote: Printed Scripture quotations: “...it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye...” (Mar 9:47); “...the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit...” (1Pe 3:4-5); “...woe to that [wo]man by whom the offence cometh!” (Mat 18:7); “Who is a wise [wo]man and endued with knowledge among you?...” (Jas 3:13); and “...denying ungodliness and worldly lusts...” (Tit 2:12).
findings.suggested_fix: Have the quotation extraction/evidence step identify these five printed Scripture quotations and provide their approved Russian verse text; then align each quotation with that evidence and provide the required Scripture selections. Do not invent or substitute Scripture wording without the approved evidence.
